title: The learning loop's own record, joined from what each seat wrote and replayed from the records alone
request: The owner: do the rest of the plan non-stop, phase 9 included; a survey found phase 9's start built as H0 to H3, and the loop's records not joined.
spec: PHASE9_LEARNING_LOOP_PLAN.md 31.17: dclab_core.loop_record v1, the variant, grade, reflection, delta and read records joined by their ids; a test replays one iteration from its records alone and traces a scoreboard row to them; a sealed variant's attempt never reaches a training set of its family.
plan: Map phase 9 to what H0 to H3 built
Read what each seat writes on disk
The contract and its replay in dclab_core
The builder over the workspace's files, to the lake's bronze layer
Keep the attempts the baseline and the draft step threw away

decisions.decision: Join the existing files rather than rewrite each seat
decisions.why: every seat already writes its part (attempt folders, results, drafts, the playbook's change log); one builder joins them by pack, run and bullet, and a rebuild gives the same records

decisions.decision: The baseline and the draft step keep a learning variant's attempt
decisions.why: they solved in a temporary folder and kept only a result row and a one-line note, so a lesson's attempt and a scoreboard row's attempts were lost

decisions.decision: Only a learning variant's attempt is open to training, and the reference arm never
decisions.why: check variants measure the lessons and sealed ones are the exam; the reference arm states the key's answers

decisions.decision: A kept folder that does not say its partition is an exam's

change: dclab_core/loop_record.py (LoopRecord v1, replay, row, training; dclab-core 0.138.0, its schemas, the conformance entry); dclab_rnd/learning/loop_records.py and the loop-records command; scoreboard.attempt keeps a learning variant's attempt; drafting keeps the attempt a lesson is drawn from; probe's tally names the delta it wrote; tests/test_loop_records.py; the plans' status.

findings.defect: The first two lessons named a pack no kept record held
findings.scenario: Building the records from the workspace and replaying them.
findings.cause: The draft step solved its own variants in a temporary folder (a pack id is a fresh token each time) and kept only a note in drafts.jsonl.
findings.fix: Each past note becomes a draft record with its codes and no kept trace; from now on the draft step keeps its attempt.

findings.defect: The reference arm's kept grade file held the answer key's column names
findings.scenario: A stored baseline, sealed included, keeps each attempt; the reference arm is solved from the key, so what it observed (columns kept out, the group) is the key; a rules-arm record open to training pointed at that file.
findings.cause: Both arms' grades and observations were kept in one file for every partition.
findings.fix: Only a learning variant's attempt is kept in a folder; the reference arm keeps its grade only.

findings.defect: Attempts on check variants were open to training
findings.scenario: training(records) on the workspace took the 20 rules-arm records of the check baseline.
findings.cause: Only a sealed split made a record an exam's; a check split stayed open.
findings.fix: The contract refuses training_allowed on any split but learning, and training() takes learning records only.

findings.defect: A probe's tally could fail to join its count delta without a word
findings.scenario: The delta's time and the tally's time come from two clock reads; a second ticking between them leaves the probe's record without its delta.
findings.cause: The join was by bullet and time to the second, and replay did not check a counted attempt had its delta.
findings.fix: The tally names the delta's index and time; replay reports a counted attempt with no count delta.

findings.defect: A kept folder without a partition was read as a check variant
findings.scenario: An attempt.json written without its partition.
findings.cause: The builder defaulted to check, which fails open.
findings.fix: It defaults to sealed: an exam's record, closed to training.

measurements.name: the workspace's loop records replayed
measurements.gate: no problem from replay, and LRN-001 and LRN-002 recount to their stored rows
measurements.result: 141 records (80 baseline, 30 draft, 20 pilot, 11 probe), no problem; 7 of 20 and 3 of 20 as stored; 71 open to training after F3

outcome: Every turn of the learning loop is a record joined by its ids, a chain replays from the records alone, every scoreboard row recounts from them, and only learning variants' attempts are open to training.
lessons: A capture that runs in a temporary folder keeps nothing: look for tempfile in any step whose output teaches.
An arm built from the answer key is the key: keep its verdict, never what it did.
Join records by the id a writer names, not by two clocks that should agree.
risks: The records are joined after the fact, not written by each seat as it acts; the loop's datasets (preferences, lessons with their effect) and the archive's copy of lake/bronze/loop are still to build.
